summary.oneLiner: Cosmic CRF Limited has demonstrated strong growth in Q4FY26, driven by capacity expansion, diversification into new segments, and strategic acquisitions, positioning itself for long-term growth and profitability.

hero.oneLiner: Cosmic CRF Limited has demonstrated strong growth in Q4FY26, driven by capacity expansion, diversification into new segments, and strategic acquisitions, positioning itself for long-term growth and profitability.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Railway segment: 60% of revenue; Infrastructure segment: 30% of revenue; Defence segment: 10% of revenue

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: INR 760 crores, with a mix of railway and infrastructure orders

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: Revenue growth: 12-15% CAGR; Margin expansion: 100-150 bps; Order inflow: INR 1,000-1,200 crores; Capex: INR 50-75 crores

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Diversification into defence equipment, expansion into new geographies, and increasing focus on exports

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Raw material prices, labour costs, and freight costs are key margin drivers

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Debt reduction, capacity expansion, and strategic acquisitions

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident and optimistic, with a focus on long-term growth and profitability

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Regulatory risks, competition, and raw material price volatility

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: The company's ability to navigate regulatory challenges and its focus on R&D and innovation
